verdict.rationale: The pricing page lists 'Strict data retention' as a plan feature and states Qodo does not train models on customer code. Self-hosted, on-premises and air-gapped deployment options give organizations indirect control over where their data lives. No documented user-facing controls for setting retention periods or deleting data appear in the evidence. Missing for 10: documented retention-period settings, user- or admin-initiated data deletion workflows, details of what 'strict data retention' actually means, independent corroboration.
